title: Consumer smart glasses
summary: Glasses that overlay digital info on the world.
whyTempting: The next computing platform after phones.
whyItFails: Battery and weight. Hardware constraints. Social stigma. Wearers face privacy backlash. Lack of killer apps. Few compelling uses.
whatWouldChange: AI assistants as the killer app; lighter displays.

attempts.notes: Consumer sales halted in January 2015; Enterprise Edition ended in March 2023.

attempts.outcome: Wrote off $40 million of unsold inventory
Acquired by Google; the glasses stopped working

reasons.detail: Social stigma: Wearers face privacy backlash.
Lack of killer apps: Few compelling uses.
